governing_law.evidence_quote: (ISDA Agreements Subject to New York Law Only)

threshold.evidence_quote: “Threshold” means with respect to Party B and any Valuation Date, infinity.

minimum_transfer_amount.evidence_quote: “Minimum Transfer Amount” means USD 100,000 with respect to Party A and Party B;

rounding.evidence_quote: The Delivery Amount will be rounded up to the nearest integral multiple of USD 10,000. The Return Amount will be rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of USD 10,000.

valuation_percentage.value: the applicable S&P/Fitch Valuation Percentage, Moody’s First Trigger Valuation Percentage, or Moody’s Second Trigger Valuation Percentage
valuation_percentage.evidence_quote: “Valuation Percentage” shall mean, for purposes of determining the S&P/Fitch Value, Moody’s First Trigger Value, or Moody’s Second Trigger Value with respect to any Eligible Collateral or Posted Collateral, the applicable S&P/Fitch Valuation Percentage, Moody’s First Trigger Valuation Percentage, or Moody’s Second Trigger Valuation Percentage for such Eligible Collateral or Posted Collateral, respectively, in each case as set forth in Paragraph 13(b)(ii).
